Marissa —

Thanks again for the quick call this morning. As we line up materials for our upcoming QBR (Sep 22), I’m attaching a short packet with the usage trends and a summary note from our product team. High level observations: 

- Monthly active API keys up 12% MoM, but average tokens per request down 18% — looks like more frequent calls with shorter contexts.
- Two production incidents in August (brief timeouts) but no customer-facing outages.
- Procurement has flagged potential budget constraints next quarter; they asked if there’s room to discuss term/seat pricing.

We’ll need an exec-level summary on renewal risk and any recommended mitigations (SLA credits, short-term pricing relief, or a joint product workshop). Can you confirm who from Redwood will present the technical stability narrative and who will own the pricing ask?

Subject: Draft: Renewal Risk Register & action matrix (BrightWorks)

Team —

I pulled together an initial Renewal Risk Register (attached). Key rows:

1) Budget pressure (probable) — Impact: high. Procurement asked for pricing flexibility; action: propose 6-month pilot at locked e-rate OR 10% term discount. Owner: Jordan.
2) Perceived stability risk (possible) — Impact: medium. Two timeouts noted in Aug; provide post-mortem, roadmap of mitigations, and 30/60-day runbook. Owner: Grace.
3) Feature fit for new use-case (low) — Impact: low. Offer joint design session. Owner: Marissa.

Next steps I recommend before the Sep 22 QBR:
- Pricing scenarios (Jordan) — produce 2 options with P&L delta. Due: Sep 20 COB.
- Technical one-pager + incident chronology (Grace) — due: Sep 19 noon.
- Consolidated exec ask deck (Marissa) — due: Sep 20 10:00am.

Date: 2027-09-19T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Prioritized exec attention items + draft talking points

Folks —

I reviewed the register and drafted the prioritized executive items for the QBR. Kept this tight for the exec deck. Highlights: 

Priority 1 — Stability narrative (requires exec time):
- Two short timeouts in Aug: root cause was a transient cache eviction under burst traffic; mitigated and patched.
- Recommended ask: publicly acknowledge issue at QBR, commit to 99.9% request success SLA over next quarter, and offer a one-time credit if SLA is missed.

Priority 2 — Procurement flexibility (commercial):
- Recommend offering a 6-month pilot pricing band (10% off list for committed usage) instead of a long-term discount; frames it as risk-sharing.

Priority 3 — Product partnership workshop:
- Offer a 2-day joint workshop to accelerate value capture for the new use-case.

Draft exec talking points included. I’ll attach an Action Matrix that maps owners and deadlines. Please review — we need sign-off from Rishi on any concession beyond the pilot pricing.

Attachments: [attachment: Action_Matrix_triage.csv]

Grace O'Connor
Sr. VP, Customer Success
